name: Karaoke captions
description: Social captions on the voice: a line or two at a time, the word being said lit by a pill that slides from word to word (or in the accent colour, or underlined), the rest of the line waiting dimmed. Give a transcript with --words; *starred* words and the ones in `accents` take the accent.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Captions keep people watching, so every *word* lands right on time.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

look.label: Highlight
look.description: pill: a block of accent behind the word being said · color: the word turns the accent · underline: a bar draws under it

ground.label: Behind the words
ground.description: shadow: straight on the footage with a soft shadow · box: a dark rounded box behind each line

parts.words: the caption lines, their highlight and box
